notes:
Account: SalesPilot Labs (mid-market SaaS building outbound SDR chat agents). Evaluating Hosted API first, with view to Dedicated reserve if POC meets latency and pricing targets.

Key requirements / context:
- Primary workload: outbound Sales/SDR chat agents that can do tool calling (CRM writes, send emails, calendar scheduling) + low-latency streaming for near real-time agent UX.
- Target latency SLO: p50 < 100ms token, p95 < 200ms streaming end-to-end for responses, tool call roundtrip <300ms ideally.
- Throughput: bursts of 200 concurrent agents during campaigns; typical sustained 40-60 concurrent. Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to commit if predictable.
- Model preferences: want Llama3-like open model variants + Redwood verified performance profiles; flexible to try smaller quantized variants for cost.
- Routing/fallback: need policy to fallback to cheaper model for non-critical responses; mandatory capability to call external tools (CRM calendar/email APIs) via function/tool-calling.
- Security/compliance: SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration for keys, data residency for EU customers; security team needs SOC2 + answers to vendor questionnaire.
